caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing with arms slightly extended. She is wearing a large, fan-shaped headdress that is predominantly green with gray and white accents, and a lace trim along the forehead. Her dress is full and consists of a bright red bodice with puffy sleeves and a skirt with lighter red horizontal stripes near the hem. Over the dress, she wears a dark brown or grayish apron with rounded edges and a slight sheen. The figure has a choker-like accessory at the neck and is also wearing light beige pants that are visible below the dress, along with red shoes. To the upper right of the central figure, there is a separate, smaller depiction of the same headdress viewed from above, revealing green stripes and a tied bow at the back. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s signature appears at the bottom right of the image.
title: Dutch Doll
